name: Basic salary
authority: Basic salary for the days employed in the month. EA s.18A (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): "Notwithstanding section 60i", an employee on a monthly rate who joins or leaves in the month, takes unpaid leave or national-service leave is paid monthly wages ÷ the days of the wage period × the days eligible — calendar days (owner ruling 2026-10-07; the Nihon salary listing prices every no-pay day and part month the same way).

name: Overtime
authority: Overtime on a normal working day at not less than 1.5 × the hourly rate (EA s.60A(3)(a)); at most 104 hours in a month (Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg.2). Rest-day and public-holiday overtime are their own lines. EA s.60I(1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.facts.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded).

name: No-pay leave
quantity: min(sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && (r.is_npl || r.pay_fraction < 1.0)).map(r, r.is_npl ? r.days : r.days * (1.0 - r.pay_fraction))), double(period.paid_days))
eligibility: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && (r.is_npl || r.pay_fraction < 1.0)).map(r, r.is_npl ? r.days : r.days * (1.0 - r.pay_fraction))) > 0.0
authority: No-pay leave and unpaid absence (and the unpaid part of any partly paid leave, 1 − pay_fraction) at the monthly salary ÷ the calendar days of the month. EA s.18A (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): "Notwithstanding section 60i", an employee on a monthly rate who joins or leaves in the month, takes unpaid leave or national-service leave is paid monthly wages ÷ the days of the wage period × the days eligible — calendar days (owner ruling 2026-10-07; the Nihon salary listing prices every no-pay day and part month the same way).

name: Leave encashment
authority: Payment for untaken annual leave at the ordinary rate of pay for every day (EA s.60E(3A)). EA s.60I(1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.facts.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded).

name: Public-holiday work
authority: Work on a paid public holiday within the normal hours: two days' wages at the ordinary rate of pay in addition to the holiday pay (EA s.60D(3)(a)(i)). EA s.60I(1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.facts.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded).

name: Overtime beyond 104 hours
authority: Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg. 2: 104 overtime hours in any one month. Hours beyond the cap are stored as incentive, not refused.
quantity: max(0.0, sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type != "REST" && !(d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"])).map(d, d.overtime_hours)) - 104.0) + work.incentive_hours
eligibility: max(0.0, sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type != "REST" && !(d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"])).map(d, d.overtime_hours)) - 104.0) + work.incentive_hours > 0.0

name: Rest-day work
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST" && !(d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"]) && d.worked_hours > 0.0).map(d, d.worked_hours - d.overtime_hours <= (has(company.facts.normal_daily_hours) ? double(company.facts.normal_daily_hours) : 8.0) / 2.0 ? 0.5 : 1.0))
authority: Work on a rest day by a monthly-rated employee within the normal hours: half a day's wages for up to half the normal hours, one day's wages for more (EA s.60(3)(a)–(b), https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf). EA s.60I(1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.facts.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded).

name: Rest-day overtime
authority: Work on a rest day beyond the normal hours at not less than 2 × the hourly rate (EA s.60(3)(c), https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf); overtime payment is not EPF or HRD wages. EA s.60I(1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.facts.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded).

name: Public-holiday overtime
authority: Overtime on a paid public holiday beyond the normal hours at not less than 3 × the hourly rate (EA s.60D(3)(a)(ii), https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf); overtime payment is not EPF or HRD wages. EA s.60I(1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): the ordinary rate of pay of a monthly-rated employee is the monthly rate ÷ 26; the hourly rate is that ÷ the normal hours of work (s.60I(1)(b), company.facts.normal_daily_hours, 8 unrecorded).
